Milnor's two elementary steps: a same-length tangent w at x gives ‖x + t•w‖ = ‖x‖√(1+t²); for n odd, (√(1+t²))^n agrees with no real polynomial on any interval (-ε, ε) (n = 3 is S²). The annulus bijection and volume step are not formalized, so the hairy ball theorem itself is not proved
